function.name: powershell
function.description: Run a PowerShell command in the current working directory (via {exe}). PREFER THIS OVER bash ON WINDOWS: bash falls through to cmd.exe here, which has no sleep, no grep, no sed, and breaks on input redirection. Native exit codes are preserved exactly; a failing cmdlet reports 1. Returns stdout and stderr, truncated to the last 2000 lines or 50KB. Optionally provide a timeout in seconds (default 120).
